headline: Cyber Incident Forces Bridgestone to Suspend Manufacturing Operations
body: Bridgestone Corporation, a leading entity in the tire and automotive components industry, experienced a significant operational standstill following a ransomware assault on its vital production and logistics systems. The attack led to the shutdown of several Bridgestone facilities as their IT teams, along with cybersecurity consultants, endeavored tirelessly to regain system functionality. While no physical harm occurred due to the incident, the interruption has caused considerable delays in shipping and has reverberated through various supply chains connected to Bridgestone. The company has not yet announced when regular production activities will recommence.
